chars.DAD: a Moroccan father around 55, short grey hair, thick grey moustache, tired stern face, beige sleeveless knit vest over a light blue button shirt, dark grey trousers
chars.SON: a 20-year-old Moroccan young man, thin moustache, black baseball cap worn backwards, oversized bright red hoodie, black joggers, white sneakers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the hallway doorway of a modest Casablanca apartment living room: DAD stands mid-gesture pointing his finger firmly at SON, angry stern face clearly visible, head-to-waist framing; SON sits on a low Moroccan sofa looking up guiltily. Main action centered, calm wall edges, no text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of DAD in the living room raising one hand with fingers spread as if saying 'I give you time', serious face looking at the viewer, Moroccan salon cushions and a small tea table behind him, warm evening light, no text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: SON in his small bedroom rapping into a cheap microphone with headphones on, eyes closed, posters-free plain wall; DAD watches from the open door with arms crossed and a sceptical face, both faces visible, no text anywhere.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In the kitchen, DAD taps his finger on a paper wall calendar showing blank month pages (no letters or numbers readable), looking hard at SON who stands nervously with hands in his hoodie pocket, no text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: At the open front door of the apartment, DAD holds the door wide with one hand and points outside to the stairwell with the other, firm face; SON stands in the corridor holding a sports bag, shocked expression, both faces visible, no text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: DAD sitting at a small table near a window of the popular-neighbourhood apartment, talking on an old mobile phone with a worried serious face, a few blank papers and a glass of mint tea in front of him, rooftops of Casablanca outside, no text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: SON sitting on the edge of his narrow bed at night, head in his hands, cap pushed back, lost and stressed, a small lamp lighting the room, phone lying on the blanket, no text.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: SON peeks through a half-open door at DAD sitting alone at the kitchen table counting a small pile of crumpled banknotes with a sad tired face, single bulb light, both faces visible, no text or readable numbers.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In a dim bedroom, DAD kneels by an old wooden wardrobe taking a worn metal tin box full of saved banknotes from under folded clothes, emotional face; SON watches silently from the doorway behind him with a guilty moved face, no text.
